summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of RideReserve (Vehicle Seat Reservation platform). Backend: 22 pytest tests, 22/22 pass individually (1 flaky under parallel workers due to test-ordering race, not a product bug). Frontend E2E via mobile viewport (390x844) passed: Phone OTP login (dev-code 123456) -> onboarding -> home with 3 seeded vehicles -> filter chips (Car/Tempo/Bus/All) -> seat grid -> checkout with correct fare breakdown -> mocked GPay payment -> ticket with QR + Call Driver button revealing driver phone. Admin flow tested via direct MongoDB promotion (as instructed). Wallet, driver-bookings list, 50/50 commission split, seat-conflict 409, unauth 401, non-admin 403 all verified. Minor: React Native deprecation warnings ('shadow*' style props, props.pointerEvents) - non-blocking web-adapter warnings.

minor.issue: Test race under pytest-xdist parallel workers: TestWallet.test_driver_wallet_after_payment can execute before TestBookings.test_create_pay_and_persist finishes on the other worker. Not a product bug; consider ordering tests or scope-locking. Passes reliably in sequential run.

issues: Taxes & fees hardcoded to ₹0.00 label - purely cosmetic since fare = fare_per_seat * seat_count matches server.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' emitted twice on login screen. Reference: styles in login.tsx / theme.ts / ui components using shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowOpacity/shadowRadius on RN Web.
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' emitted on navigation. Non-blocking, but should migrate pointerEvents to style prop.

Anti-pattern: setTimeout(() => router.replace(...), 0) is invoked during render body (line 23-25) when user is already logged in. Should be wrapped in useEffect to avoid setState-in-render side effects and duplicate navigation on Fast Refresh. Reference: /app/frontend/app/login.tsx:23-25

action_items: Replace `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` where used (theme / ui components) to silence RN Web deprecation warning.
Migrate any `pointerEvents` prop usage to `style.pointerEvents` (search codebase for `pointerEvents=`).
Move the `if (user) setTimeout(router.replace(...))` block in /app/frontend/app/login.tsx into a useEffect(() => { if (user) router.replace(...) }, [user]).
(Optional) Constrain parallel pytest by scope-lock to eliminate the wallet-timing flake in xdist runs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 776-line file; acceptable for MVP but consider splitting routers (auth/vehicles/bookings/wallet/admin) if it grows further.
OTP verify accepts hard-coded 123456 and does NOT enforce phone-numeric validation - fine for MVP (mocked auth) but must be replaced before production.
vehicles/mine, bookings/mine, bookings/driver/list correctly use per-user filters and 401 unauth; admin routes 403 for non-admins - RBAC correct.
Driver phone hidden until booking.status == 'paid' - matches spec.
50/50 commission split verified via commission_rate env default 0.5; driver_earning + platform_commission == total_amount.
Storage.init_storage() runs on startup but network failures are only logged (warning); good.
seed_data_creation: None manually created. Used seeded demo driver (+919000000001) and 3 seeded approved vehicles (veh_demo_car_01 / tempo_01 / bus_01). Test-created users use TEST_ / E2E_ prefixed names and unique phones.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints under /api behave per spec. Use EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for e2e. Phone OTP: any phone + code '123456'. Admin: promote user via Mongo (is_admin=true, active_role='admin'). Seeded vehicles: veh_demo_car_01 (car, 4 seats, ₹450), veh_demo_tempo_01 (tempo, 12 seats, ₹700), veh_demo_bus_01 (bus, 32 seats, ₹950).
